title: 完成所有交易的初始最少钱数
summary: 每笔交易先支付 cost 后返还 cashback，必须保证无论以何种顺序执行都能完成全部交易，求所需的最少初始金额。
insight: 所有亏损交易必造成 totalLoss=sum(max(0,cost-cashback))。最后承担峰值的某笔交易还需在总亏损之外准备 min(cost,cashback)，取所有交易最大值。
pitfalls: 即使盈利交易也可能决定最后峰值

solutions.title: 总亏损加最大末笔缓冲
solutions.idea: 把不可避免亏损与单笔启动资金分离。

code.java: class Solution { public long minimumMoney(int[][] transactions){long loss=0,buffer=0;for(int[] transaction:transactions){loss+=Math.max(0,transaction[0]-transaction[1]);buffer=Math.max(buffer,Math.min(transaction[0],transaction[1]));}return loss+buffer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumMoney(transactions:Array<IntArray>):Long{var loss=0L;var buffer=0L;for(transaction in transactions){loss+=maxOf(0,transaction[0]-transaction[1]);buffer=maxOf(buffer,minOf(transaction[0],transaction[1]).toLong())};return loss+buffer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long minimumMoney(vector<vector<int>>& transactions){long long loss=0,buffer=0;for(auto& transaction:transactions){loss+=max(0,transaction[0]-transaction[1]);buffer=max(buffer,(long long)min(transaction[0],transaction[1]));}return loss+buffer;} };
